description: Paid (price: see tabularium_menu). Use when the memory should outlast its term: adds 30 days from the later of now or the current expiry, so renewing early wastes nothing (tabularium_head shows the expiry for free). After expiry there is a 90-day grace period (read, export and renew work, writes do not), then the data is deleted. Charged before it runs; a missing workspace is refused free.
name: tabularium_renew
title: Renew the workspace
